symptom: Upper Structure Overruns Too Much When It Stops Swing Operation (Only One Direction)
detail_of_failure: The upper structure overruns too much when it stops swing operation (only one direction).
related_information: Pre-troubleshooting If a failure code is shown, do the troubleshooting for that code first. Monitoring code • F pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01100) • R pump pressure can be examined with the monitoring function. (Code: 01101)

branches.YES: • The swing PPC valve is normal. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing PPC valve is defective. • Replace the swing PPC valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Swing RIGHT PPC slow return valve
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the swing RIGHT and LEFT slow return valves. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • Swing RIGHT PPC slow return valve is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • When the swing RIGHT PPC slow return valve is removed, examine the strainer for clogging. • If the strainer is clogged, clean the strainer or replace the swing RIGHT PPC slow return valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping to do the troubleshooting. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Examine the control valve body and the swing spool to see if they are not twisted or stuck and that they do not have any damage or dirt on them. (They must move smoothly and not be stuck.) REMARK Be careful that dirt does not enter during recovery work.

branches.YES: • The swing control valve body and spool are correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • The swing control valve body and spool are defective. • Replace the body and spool of the swing control valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.

steps.cause: Left suction valve of swing motor
steps.procedure: 1. Release the pressure that remains in the hydraulic tank and piping. For details, see Testing and Adjusting, “Release Remained Pressure in Hydraulic Circuit”. 2. Interchange the right and left suction valves of the swing motor. 3. Is there no change, and does the phenomenon reproduce?

branches.YES: • The left suction valve of the swing motor is correct. • Go to the next check item.
branches.NO: • Examine the left suction valve of the swing motor for sticking, scratches, or other abnormalities when it is removed. • If the left suction valve of the swing motor is stuck or scratched, replace the valve. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
